items.evidence: README headless command from work/ (`leverage play . --ticks 600 --seed 1 --settings ... --inputs "0:enter,1:up+shoot,40:down+shoot,80:none"`) printed one JSON object with tick 600 and every brief field (plus an extra 'phase'); --ticks 0 printed screen 'title', menu_index 0, texts [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit].
README frame command (output path pointed to judge-scratch) wrote a PNG; header says 800x480; same for 10 other frames of all screens. Opened and viewed.
Title texts [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit]; '0:down,1:enter' -> screen settings; '0:enter' 3 ticks -> screen play, wave 1, score 0, gate_health 5, texts [Score: 0, Wave 1 of 5, Gate: 5].
Default 8; one Right -> 9; five Rights -> 10 (stops); three Lefts -> 5; eleven Lefts -> 0 (stops). Texts show 'Volume: N' accordingly.

Settings, Down, Right -> language es, settings texts [Ajustes, Volumen: 8, Idioma: Español, Atrás] (and the title beneath: Defiende la puerta, Empezar, Ajustes, Salir); title run -> all Spanish; play -> [Puntos: 0, Oleada 1 de 5, Puerta: 5]; paused/lost also Spanish (En pausa/Continuar/Título, Has perdido/Intro: título). No English left.

Run 1 set volume 3 + Spanish with --settings judge-scratch/p1 (settings.json written with volume 3, language es); run 2 with --ticks 0 same folder starts language es, volume 3; fresh folder starts en, volume 8.
Up held 30 ticks: guard_y 6 -> 9.0; down 60 ticks -> 0.0 (6 units/s); up 300 ticks -> 12 (clamped); down 400 ticks -> 0 (clamped).

Shoot held from tick 51 at y=1: new bolt at ticks 52, 76, 100 (24 apart); x advances 0.2333/tick (14/s); bolt at 19.967 at tick 128 is gone at tick 129. Rapid shoot/none taps over 10 ticks gave only 1 bolt.
Seed 1 no input: walkers appear at ticks 1, 91, 181, 271, 361 (90 ticks apart), exactly 5, lanes 4,10,6,2,6, x falls 0.025/tick (1.5/s), spacing 2.25 units; no 6th walker by tick 800.

Guard at y=4 fires 2 bolts: tick 89 walker (lane 4) health 2->1 and bolt gone; tick 111 walker destroyed, score 10. Bolt at y=4.7 passed the lane-4 walker untouched (4.6 hit); bolt at y=6 passed it too.

No input: tick 800 first walker at x=0, tick 801 it is gone and gate 5->4; tick 1161 gate 0, screen lost, texts [..., You lost, Score: 0, Enter: title]; lost frame shows 'You lost', 'Score: 0'. Enter there -> title.

Follow-mode trace of my own winning script (seed 1): wave 1's last walker gone at tick 494, wave 2 and its first walker at tick 674 (180 ticks = 3 s); wave 2 spawned 7 walkers 90 ticks apart; texts 'Wave 2 of 5' (Spanish 'Oleada N de 5' seen too). Waves 3-5 spawned 9, 11, 13.

My own reactive bot's recorded script, replayed as a plain headless run (seed 1, 5227 ticks): screen won, score 450, gate 5, texts [..., You won, Score: 450, Enter: title]; adding Enter at 5228 -> screen title.

Escape at tick 101: state at tick 300 identical to tick 101 (walkers, bolts, guard frozen), screen paused, texts Paused/Resume/Title; Enter (Resume) -> play continuing from the same positions (17.475 -> 17.425 after 2 ticks); Down+Enter (Title) -> screen title.
Two runs seed 7, 700 ticks, same script: byte-identical output (cmp). Lanes seed 7 [6,10,6,10,8], seed 2 [10,10,6,10,8], seed 1 [4,10,6,2,6].

Frames at ticks 300, 400 (es), 760: at 40 px/unit every walker, guard (x=2) and bolt sits exactly where the JSON puts it (e.g. walker (12.5,4) at px (500,320), bolts at x 4.57/10.17/15.77 on y=6); brown gate on left; HUD shows Score, Wave N of 5, Gate.

Title frame (English and Spanish) shows name and Start/Settings/Quit with a focus ring on Settings after Down; settings frames show Volume/Language/Back with focus ring on Volume (English) and on 'Idioma: Español' (Spanish), all words in the chosen language.

assets/strings/en.json and es.json hold all words, same keys; screens in assets/ui reference @keys; lib.rs has no shown strings. README 'Adding a language' section explains copying en.json to <code>.json (not tried: I may not write in work/).

README gives keys and rules for play and the two commands; both ran as written from work/ (I only redirected the PNG and --settings folder into judge-scratch to avoid writing in work/); the frame command gave a byte-identical PNG to my own run.

defects: `texts` on the settings screen also lists the title screen's four strings, which are hidden behind the settings panel in the frame (not 'on screen now').
After Title from pause (or Enter from won), the JSON on the title screen still reports the old run's score, walkers and bolts (README admits it).
Guard at y=12 (or 0) is drawn half outside the field; at the top it sits under the HUD panel.
On the title screen Start keeps its blue 'primary' fill when not focused, so two buttons look highlighted; only the focus ring marks the chosen one.
README headless and frame commands as written write into the work folder (./saved, frame.png).
